column8: Patients in late stage of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) were selected and sampled prior to tumour treatment. There were a total of 56 patients, including 41 males and 15 females, aged 44–76 years. The patient sera were equally and randomly pooled into two groups to obtain a general view of its effects on DCs and to minimize individual variation. All blood serum samples were incubated at 56°C in water bath for 30min to deactivate complement activity prior used in cell growth medium.
